summary: define historical market and exact strategy-run replay semantics
owner_direction: Preserve MarketState(t) as canonical historical market truth, RunState(run_id,t) as the exact persisted state of one completed historical simulation without rerunning strategy code, and ReplayFrame(run_id,t) as their composition. Reuse canonical datasets, existing replay, backtest and accounting; do not duplicate full market timelines per run or create parallel engines. Add the smallest successor task and planning/spec updates required; do not implement application code.
